requiredEvidence.automatic: New jobs populate automatically from your profile.

scenes.vo: You find a job that looks perfect.
scenes.headline: looks perfect.
scenes.newInformation: The viewer recognizes the appealing-job moment.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A promising card drops into reach.

scenes.vo: Great company. Right role. You tick the boxes.
scenes.headline: TICK THE BOXES.
scenes.newInformation: The role appears to meet the viewer’s priorities.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Three large checkmarks land one by one.

scenes.vo: Then you notice one tiny detail.
scenes.headline: one tiny detail.
scenes.newInformation: Posting age is the overlooked detail.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A small timestamp sits in a large empty frame.
scenes.transition: A hard cut magnifies the detail.

scenes.headline: THREE DAYS AGO.
scenes.newInformation: The captured older posting says three days ago.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The age takes over the entire frame with its original pixel strip.
scenes.transition: Return to the presenter for the emotional consequence.

scenes.headline: HOW DID YOU MISS IT?
scenes.newInformation: Repeated searching still feels like missed timing.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The presenter leans into the unanswered question.
scenes.transition: An empty cream reset introduces the product.

scenes.headline: Meet Solomon.
scenes.newInformation: Solomon is the product being introduced.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A clean wordmark and presenter entrance reset the tension.

scenes.vo: Your profile tells it what you’re looking for.
scenes.headline: YOUR PROFILE.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Criteria chips merge into a single profile object; labelled illustration.
scenes.transition: The profile becomes a source for the feed.

scenes.vo: New jobs populate your feed automatically.
scenes.headline: automatically.
scenes.newInformation: The actual product describes automatic population of the feed.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The product’s own explanation appears as an enlarged proof strip.
scenes.transition: Show the benefit of not repeating the search.

scenes.vo: So you don’t have to keep running the same search.
scenes.headline: THE SAME SEARCH.
scenes.newInformation: Automatic population reduces the need to repeat discovery.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Repeated query cards collapse; the presenter exits while the profile remains.
scenes.transition: Return to the application rather than promising instant alerts.

scenes.headline: OPEN YOUR FEED.
scenes.newInformation: The feed contains concrete role listings.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A wide application view cuts to one authentic job headline above the returning presenter.

scenes.headline: THIRTEEN HOURS OLD.
scenes.newInformation: The second captured listing says thirteen hours ago.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A large thirteen replaces the three-day motif, backed by source pixels.

scenes.headline: NEWEST FIRST.
scenes.newInformation: The product offers Newest First sorting.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The authentic select control grows to readable scale.

scenes.vo: Different listings. Days old, or hours old.
scenes.headline: DAYS. OR HOURS.
scenes.newInformation: The ages belong to two different jobs and dated captures.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The old age sinks; the newer age rises. Both source strips stay visible.
scenes.transition: The age contrast prompts a better habit.

scenes.vo: Now ask a better question. What changed?
scenes.headline: What changed?
scenes.newInformation: Ask what changed instead of repeating the same search.
scenes.visualMetaphor: A crossed-out old question is replaced with one large new question.
scenes.transition: The question resolves into the human payoff.

scenes.vo: Finding the right job matters. Finding it fresh matters too.
scenes.headline: right. and fresh.
scenes.newInformation: Suitability and freshness are separate things to consider.
scenes.visualMetaphor: Two short phrases become a balanced pair.
scenes.transition: Close with a calm callback to less searching.

scenes.vo: Search less. Find what matters. Meet Solomon.
scenes.headline: Search less.
scenes.newInformation: Solomon is associated with less repetitive searching.
scenes.visualMetaphor: The last card closes; only the presenter and the brand remain.
scenes.transition: End without an unverified URL or delivery promise.
